findings.location: design.md:36-38 ("Tests that set their own `format` are not affected"), design.md:61-62, design.md:72; specs/statusline/spec.md:5 ("in front of its default format")
findings.finding: The design states the default label only in front of the default format and lists only unlabelled-default assertions as flipping. The mechanism puts a default label in front of whatever format binds, configured or default, when no label is configured (instrument-binding.ts:26-29), exactly as README.md:133-134 warns for thinking. Measured by applying the six declaration lines in a scratch copy: 38 of 309 tests fail, among them tests that configure a model/context format and no label (configuration.test.ts:919 renders `Model:` where "" was expected under format ""; :1014 `Model: ` before the styled model; the `$bar` prose test renders `Context: [░]`). Six living-spec scenarios that configure a model format and pin unlabelled text become false as written: openspec/specs/statusline/spec.md:741-743, 776, 787, 926, 932-933, 939. The delta leaves them untouched, which is the spec-contradicts-code defect the council accepted Matt's correction to avoid. The user-visible break is also unnamed: a document with `"format": ""` or any format and no label on model, path, context, tokens or cost now shows the label.
findings.required_change: (1) Design: state that a default label precedes a configured format too, that `format: ""` on the five now renders the label alone, and that `label: ""` is the way back; name this in Risks and the README upgrading note. (2) Design rules how format-language tests and scenarios isolate the format from the default: either their WHEN sets `label: ""`, or their THEN states the label. One rule, applied to all six scenarios and the matching tests. (3) Delta: the ADDED requirement says "in front of its format, configured or default", and MODIFIES the six scenarios per the rule chosen (re-measure paragraph lengths under 500). (4) Decision 5 lists the flip set from the failing run, which is 38 tests, not 36 assertion lines.

findings.finding: "the test titled 'no label and no default label renders as before' (configuration.test.ts:449 region)" is wrong twice: it is an assertion message, not a title, and it sits at configuration.test.ts:588 in the test starting at :580. Line 449 is a DEFAULT_CELL_TEXT assertion in another test. The failing run names :588.
findings.required_change: Cite configuration.test.ts:580-588 and call it the assertion it is.
